readOnlyReviewOperations: Read assigned review prompt and recorded phase-start.json using UTC/Python.
Read only own original reports, observation JSON, source capsule and public design.
Viewed all 34 contact sheets in contact-sheet-index.json, preserving state labels and original snapshot indices.
Read original native room mute/music/control facts, state bindings and caller update dispatch.
Sampled two original iOS disabled-control flat pixels and compared all 93 original source/plan files.

limits: No source, plan, design, bridge or action edits. No SDK, render, observer, preview, app launch or new screenshot command.
Original typed expectations, units, precision and routes remain unchanged; every original typed failure is retained with its ID and product/observation classification.
Generic iOS computed font size/weight/color/ellipsis remain unassessed. Screenshot appearance conclusions do not expose those properties.
P2 leveled activation was blocked_disabled on both platforms; callback behavior for that stimulus remains unassessed.
Loaded/replaced visual full-content claims use only their original stable complete sweeps. Other state reviews remain scoped to the inspected regions.
Android uses semantic Compose OnClick dispatch and parent native scroll displacement, not physical OS touches or Activity lifecycle coverage.
Android parent canvas differs from the public role and is explicitly painted by the original host; attribution remains unassessed.
No independent native behavior is inferred for unexercised controls, zero-audible seeds, negative-level clamp inputs or live confirmation paths absent from these original public routes.
No repairs performed; stop pending the all-six original review barrier.
